mathematical_basis: The July 2026 odd-degree theorem proves every Hodge class on every odd Fermat fourfold of degree <=199 is algebraic. Therefore any Hodge sextuple at an odd divisor d of an even wall level M is an algebraic candidate after the standard level inflation d -> M. Coset transfer would require its inflated multiplicity vector to lie in the target S_M coset.
search_method: Enumerate every sorted triple at odd divisor d; pair complementary full Galois-residue profiles to produce every grade-3 Hodge sextuple; simultaneously require equality of the mod-2 quotient remainder for S_M after inflation. Additive hashes are used only as a candidate index and all possible exact matches would necessarily match the hashes; zero raw matches therefore cannot be a hash false-negative.
positive_calibration: Using the level-21 classical gap generator inflated to level 210 as the target, the same engine finds same-coset Hodge candidates, so the combined Hodge/coset matching path is active rather than vacuously empty.

extra_checks.m21_gap_generator_inflated_to_210: checked separately; remains a gap but not the W70 coset

result: Direct inflation from any odd divisor level whose Hodge classes are covered by the 2026 odd-degree theorem cannot supply a same-coset witness for W70@210, W110@220, or W114@114.
claim_ceiling: This excludes only direct divisor-level inflation followed by the current coset-transfer theorem. It does not exclude non-divisor level correspondences, larger lifts followed by descent, new exchange families, or new geometric cycle constructions. No P-vs-NP evidence is used.
